_enabledPluginsComment: Two-tier profile (always vs on-demand). This map carries the ALWAYS tier (`true` — installed AND enabled on every himmel machine) plus every spec the installers must NOT enable (`false`). A `false` entry is one of two things, and `onDemandPlugins` below is what tells them apart: a spec LISTED there is the ON-DEMAND tier (installed by the installers, written here as `false`, reachable via `/profile enable <spec>`); a spec absent from it is simply NOT INSTALLED. Keep every on-demand spec present here as `false` — reconcile-enabled-plugins.sh writes this map verbatim, so an omitted spec would be appended as false anyway, and the presence-verify in install-plugins.sh reads this key.
_onDemandPluginsComment: ON-DEMAND tier: INSTALLED by install-plugins.sh but left DISABLED, so the plugin is reachable (`/profile enable <spec>`, or a cadence's own force-enable fragment) without costing session-start context on every launch. `neededBy` names WHO wants it, so discovery can say 'enable X for Y'. Every key here MUST also appear in enabledPlugins as `false` (check-template-himmel-plugins.sh enforces that), and its marketplace MUST be in extraKnownMarketplaces.
